name: Hale
self_text: I am a Spanish woman in my late 30s. I use a Nikon. Outside of photography, I love swing dancing for the energy and music. Honestly, I'm just looking for a practice session working on specific shots. I tend to go at a slow pace, that's how I enjoy it. I'm cool with not taking portraits of each other. Most weeks I can do Saturday afternoon or Sunday morning.

requests.request_text: I need you to be okay with a slow pace or a moderate pace. You have to be into a structured instruction session or a practice session working on specific shots. It would be nice if you are okay with not taking portraits of each other, but no big deal.
